Securo 0.19.0 with plugins and a dashboard you arrange yourself, a compose file for other Docker hosts, and security updates across the image.

## ✨ Added

- **A compose file for other Docker hosts.** `compose.yaml` runs Securo on any Linux server with Docker. The README explains the setup on Synology, Proxmox, MOS, ZimaOS, CasaOS and umbrelOS.

## 🎨 Design

- The README has buttons for the MOS Hub, the ZimaOS and Umbrel app stores and the compose file, grouped under titles, and draws its section headings as chapter bands. The banner carries a new claim, and the in-development notice is gone.

## ⚡ Improved

- **Securo 0.19.0.** You can arrange the dashboard's widgets and pick one of nine themes, Reports gain an income and expense statement, and bank providers are set up under Admin. Upstream's [release notes](https://github.com/securo-finance/securo/releases) have the full list, loan contracts and category splits included.
- **Plugins from upstream's catalog** bring categories, rules and themes and stay off until you set `PLUGINS_ENABLED=true`. Plugins with code need upstream's separate runner containers and are not part of this image yet.
- **Database migrations on the first start**, eight in the newest Securo alone. That start takes a little longer than usual, so back up the data folder before you update.
- **Security updates.** The build installs the Debian fixes published since upstream built its image, libpq 17.12 among them. soupsieve 4.1.1, Pillow 13.0.0, opentelemetry-api 1.45.2, pypdf 7.1.0, pyasn1 0.6.5, dnspython 2.9.2, PyJWT 2.15.1, certifi 2026.10.23, urllib3 2.8.0 and pip 26.3 replace versions with open advisories.
- The newest release is rebuilt every Sunday on fresh base images, and the rebuild carries the release's version and commit. gosu is at 1.20.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **`REGISTRATION_ENABLED=false` closes sign-up.** A value Securo saved on its first start overrode the variable, so sign-up stayed open. The update removes that saved value, and the variable decides until an administrator changes the setting in the app.
